notes.title: Experience & loot fixes
notes.content:
Experience rewarded has been balanced to scale with player level, at the same time experience for ship kills has been severely reduced to better reflect the next experience required.

Fixed an issue with Loot dropping where the boss would either drop all items or none, now each item has a 70% to drop

notes.title: Fixed Talia
notes.content: Fixed an exception for Talia's Overdrive skilltree which corrupted the save, Overdrive upgrade list was empty by default for talia, fixed the prefab, now it works, but it doesn't fix old saves
